cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I'll host Christmas, within our family's shared-effort rule.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hosting counts as effort. The kitchen's yours if you'll cook.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So I do the cooking in your house?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rule shares effort, not ownership. You can use my best pans.

reason: A offers kitchen and tools to secure B cooking while construing shared effort as protection from cooking personally.
